pages.text: Check your keys here rather than on a wiki. Every key on these pages renders live from your bindings and stays correct after you rebind.$(br2)Out of the box, 420+ mods registered $(bold)339 keybinds$(), $(bold)161$() of them colliding. The pack ships its own defaults that clear the worst conflicts, so casters and martial classes don't fight their own keyboard.

pages.title: Numpad Armor Abilities
pages.text: All armor set abilities defaulted to caster keys; the pack moved them to the Numpad:$(br2)$(bold)Cataclysm:$() $(k:cataclysm.boots_ability) boots · $(k:cataclysm.helmet_ability) helmet · $(k:cataclysm.ability) generic · $(k:cataclysm.chestplate_ability) chestplate$(br)$(bold)MekaSuit:$() $(k:mekanism.head_mode) head · $(k:mekanism.feet_mode) feet · $(k:mekanism.chest_mode) chest · $(k:mekanism.legs_mode) legs$(br)$(bold)Ad Astra suit:$() $(k:ad_astra.toggle_suit_flight) toggle flight$(br)$(bold)Terramity armor:$() $(k:terramity.armor_set_bonus_ability) set bonus · $(k:terramity.dash_ability) dash · $(k:terramity.slam) slam

pages.title: Unbound Keys
pages.text: Some niche keybinds ship unbound to clear conflicts. Each still works once you assign it a key in the controls menu:$(br2)$(bold)Voice Chat$(): opt-in$(br)$(bold)AdHooks$() (grappling): hijacked mouse/Space/Shift/Ctrl$(br)$(bold)Occultism Backpack$(): use Sophisticated Backpacks instead

pages.title: Unbound Keys, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Deeper & Darker Transmit$(), $(bold)More Artifacts$() eyes, $(bold)Botania Corporea Request$(): niche$(br2)Mods that drifted onto the caster keys above were unbound too.

pages.title: Overlaps by Context
pages.text: Some keys look like collisions in the controls menu $(italic)but only ever fire one at a time$(), each in a different game state:$(br2)$(bold)JEI keybinds$(): only with the JEI overlay up$(br)$(bold)JourneyMap fullscreen keys$(): only inside the map UI$(br)$(bold)Jade$() (numpad): only when the tooltip is showing$(br)$(bold)Crafting Tweaks$(): only inside crafting screens$(br)$(bold)Trash Slot$(): only inside your inventory

pages.title: Customizing
pages.text: The bundled defaults are a starting point. Your own changes survive pack updates, because the pack only fills in defaults when $(thing)options.txt$() is freshly created.$(br2)$(bold)Next: Options, then Controls.$() Type a mod's name in the search bar to filter the list to that mod's keys, and bind your favorites from the Unbound page while you're there.
